chrome-cdp fixtures

This origin: {{ORIGIN}}. The other site: {{ORIGIN_B}}.

  • tabs/popup.html: window.open and target=_blank popups
  • frames/cross-origin.html: an iframe from the other site (an OOPIF)
  • frames/nested.html: same-site and cross-site iframes, nested two deep
  • nav/a.html and nav/b.html: two plain pages that link to each other
  • nav/spa.html: a pushState router whose views render late
  • nav/slow-image.html: DOMContentLoaded at once, load after a slow image
  • nav/js-redirect.html: location.replace to nav/b.html while loading
  • /redirect?to=<path>&n=<hops>: a chain of 302 redirects
  • workers/worker.html: a dedicated worker
  • targets/matrix.html: every kind of frame and worker (plan 13)
  • dialogs/on-load.html?kind=alert|confirm|prompt&message=: a dialog while the page loads
  • dialogs/beforeunload.html: asks before leaving (after a click)
  • downloads/: links to files served as attachments
  • auth/: needs HTTP basic auth (ada / s3cret)
  • actions/: actionability (obscured, moving, states, scroll, shadow, frames); every page logs clicks in #log. Mouse and pointer: mouse (event log), dnd (HTML5), sortable (pointer events), feed (infinite scroll), touch
  • apps/: the same todo app in React, Vue and Svelte, prebuilt (vendor/ holds the framework builds)
  • snapshot/: the snapshot corpus (simple, login, forms, hidden, clickable, lists-tables, widgets, modal, shadow, frames, article, big-app, huge, and plan 16's cards), each with an .expected tree
  • forms/: forms and fill-form (checkout: every field kind, a field that appears after a choice; two-forms: a login and a newsletter; framed: both in iframes)
  • compare/: compare (a.html and b.html differ in a heading, a button, a link, a moved block and a colour)
  • explore/: explore (a small app with a known map: a client-side route, a modal, a destructive button, a form, a 404 link, an error)
  • refs/: elements that re-render or move, for ref stability
  • locators/: every locator kind, ambiguous matches, frames
  • read/: text, markdown and html reading
  • wait/: slow requests and scripts, lazy content, animations, beacons
  • eval/: eval, with source-mapped bundles
  • console/: console calls, exceptions, CSP reports, a worker, source maps; soak.html logs 100 messages a second
  • network/: requests of every kind, for the network log
  • har/: a page to record as HAR
  • perf/: load timing and Web Vitals
  • coverage/: partly unused JavaScript and CSS
  • source/: pages that fake a framework's debug info, for source and components
  • debug/: a page with a debugger; statement, for logpoints
  • hmr/: fake Vite and webpack-dev-server clients (webpack), for wait --hmr
  • shots/: screenshots: tall pages, frames, annotations, page sizes
  • route/: requests to mock or block, from frames and a service worker
  • mock/: pages whose requests mock files answer
  • record/: a shop whose API calls are recorded as mocks
  • record/testids.html: two buttons told apart by data-test only
  • emulate/: devices, permissions and frames under emulation
  • inject/: init scripts and exposed functions
  • state/: a login kept in cookies and storage
  • expect/: assertions: errors, accessibility, baselines, moving elements
  • why/: one element per reason an action waits, for why
  • layout/: a page per kind of layout finding (covered, contrast, …) and a clean one
  • issues/: pages that make Chrome raise issues (CORS, CSP, cookies, deprecations, quirks mode, forms), in frames and a worker; golden.html for the goldens
  • a11y/: a page per accessibility rule of expect --a11y (heading-order, target-size, …) and a clean one
  • audit/: a page per audit category with one known finding (security, meta, …), a clean one and golden.html
  • script/: a login for .cdp scripts
  • bench/: the benchmarks' pages: micro timings, and the agent tasks (they post results to /bench/record)
  • e2e/: the test runner's shop (its API is /e2e/api/) and determinism checks

Any path takes ?delay=<ms>, ?status=<code> and ?download=<name>.
